data.title: Consumer price inflation, UK: October 2026
data.summary:
Price indices percentage changes and weights for the different measures of consumer price inflation.
Consumer prices consumption segment indices and price quotes dataset
Detailed lower level indices, price quote data, and further microdata outputs supporting CPI, CPIH and RPI statistics. These supporting data are not accredited official statistics, but publication alongside our headline measures of inflation provides greater transparency and enables more detailed analysis of consumer price movements.
